standards.description: The Standards axis in one or two sentences.

spec.description: The Spec axis in one or two sentences, or why there is no spec.

findings.description: Every finding from both axes, one per problem. Empty is fine.

title.description: The finding in a few words, plain text.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository root.

line.description: A line in the file after the change, inside a diff hunk when possible.

body.description: Markdown: the rule or spec line it breaks, what is wrong, what to do instead.

missingRules.description: Anything you wanted to fail the change for that no standard covers.
